name: Glaze
summary: A frosted glass code field where each box flips over and turns mint as you fill it
about: A 4-digit one-time code field made of frosted glass over slowly drifting colour blobs. Every digit flips its cell over to a fresh mint colour, and a right code sends a wave through the cells and turns the lock badge into a check. Good for login checks, two-step verification and email confirmation.
how: Type, paste or autofill the demo code; backspace and arrow keys move between cells
Each cell flips over and turns mint as soon as it gets a digit
When all four are filled the code is checked
A right code runs a wave through the cells and the lock badge becomes a check
A wrong code turns the cells rose, shakes them and clears them
